title: A stack buffer overflow in ProcXTestFakeInput DeviceValuator handling in X.Org xwayland before 24.1.15 and X server…
description: A stack buffer overflow vulnerability exists in the ProcXTestFakeInput DeviceValuator handling in X.Org xwayland before version 24.1.15 and X server before version 21.1.26. This flaw could allow authenticated clients to crash the X server or potentially execute arbitrary code within it.
